metaTitle: Custom Unisex Embroidered Patches | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom unisex embroidered patches for teams, uniforms, or events. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Unisex embroidered patches offer a versatile option for teams, uniforms, and promotional events where a single design works for all genders. Whether you're outfitting a corporate safety crew or a community volunteer group, these patches provide a consistent, professional look. Choose from a variety of shapes and sizes, with full-color embroidery that holds up to repeated wear and washing. Perfect for sewn-on or iron-on application, they're a reliable way to display your logo or message.
heroAltText: Custom unisex embroidered patches with colorful logo designs on a denim jacket
